title: Recover a Base-only pending source-root intent after restart with token but no work binding
outcome: A Base-only session can safely settle its exact pending or orphaned source-root naming intent after restart without requiring turn-gated control or fabricating a grant.
acceptance: A regression loses a named_root_bind reply, persists and reloads the same store, and demonstrates recovery of the exact pending or orphaned intent with turnGatedControl=false, routing_token present and runtime work_binding absent.
Recovery revalidates exact held claim/store/run/fence and existing owner/runtime/durability boundaries; it does not publish an unproven outcome, create a grant, or weaken admission guards.
